conditions.ar: تجميع تعهد شراء ملتزم للمشاريع لا يقل عن 3.6 ألف طن عبر المشترين المسمّين قبل استثمار المنتجين القائمين في القوالب والتأهيل.
conditions.en: Aggregate committed project offtake of at least 3.6 kt across the named buyers before the incumbents invest in dies and qualification.

conditions.ar: لا يُمنح دعم مالي؛ يقتصر التدخل على تنسيق المشتريات.
conditions.en: No financial support is granted; the intervention is procurement coordination only.

headline.ar: تقدّم مُحاكى — تعهد شراء مجمّع للمنتجين القائمين لقطاعات الألومنيوم
headline.en: SIMULATED ADVANCE — aggregated procurement commitment for the incumbent extruders

kill_conditions.ar: انخفاض تعهد الشراء الملتزم إلى أقل من حجم التعادل للقوالب والتأهيل.
kill_conditions.en: Committed offtake falls below the die and qualification break-even volume.

kill_conditions.ar: عودة المشترين إلى القطاعات المستوردة بعد التأهيل.
kill_conditions.en: Buyers revert to imported profiles after qualification.

rationale.ar: تُظهر أدلة المحاكاة بمستوى الوزارة منتجين قائمين لديهم طاقة فائضة وخليطة ومعالجة مكافئتين، بينما يتشتت الطلب على القطاعات المستهدفة بين مشاريع كثيرة؛ ويجعل تعهد الشراء المجمّع والمشروط الاستثمار في القوالب والعدد والتأهيل قابلاً للتمويل دون دعم رأسمالي.
rationale.en: The simulated Ministry-grade evidence shows incumbent extruders with spare capacity and an equivalent alloy/temper, while target-profile demand is fragmented across many projects; an aggregated, conditional offtake makes the die, tooling and qualification investment bankable without capital support.

route_label.ar: تجميع الطلب أو التزام الشراء أو تعهد الشراء المشروط (المسار 4)
route_label.en: Demand aggregation, procurement commitment or conditional offtake (route 4)

headline.ar: تحقّق مُحاكى — ما زالت بوابة واحدة أو أكثر غير محسومة
headline.en: SIMULATED INVESTIGATE — one or more gates remain unresolved

rationale.ar: لم يستوف فرع المحاكاة جميع البوابات الصلبة.
rationale.en: The simulated branch did not satisfy every hard gate.

route_label.en: Simulation controls did not all pass

ground_truth.basis: Core 06 §5.3 planted ground truth; Core 07 §7.7 and §7.6 step 3: the demand-aggregation/conditional-offtake record passes every gate with zero financial support, the quantity gap (qualified availability below target demand) makes route 0 fail, routes 1–3 and 6 fail by constraint class, route 5 fails proportionality, route 7 is blocked by the lower fully-resolving route; public R2/R3/R9-S and synthetic R5/R7/R8 execute FULL.

seed_basis: Public 2024 imports of HS 7604.29 (9.189841 kt, USD 51.78 M; UN Comtrade H6 series) bound the buyer and tariff-line allocations and the target demand; ALUPCO and TALCO spans establish extrusion (Class C) without a numeric nameplate, so the synthetic line and its qualified share are an explicit design basis.

route_evidence.basis: Aggregated, conditional project offtake enabling incumbent die, tooling and qualification investment without financial support.
Capital support for expansion is disproportionate while incumbents hold spare extrusion capacity.

label.en: (synthetic design basis) shared aluminium billet and foil-stock casthouse supply
label.ar: (أساس تصميم محاكى) إمداد مشترك من مسبك الألومنيوم بالكتل ومخزون الرقائق

shared_enabler.basis: Synthetic counterfactual only: assume coordinated aluminium billet/foil-stock supply is an enabling alternative addressing the named downstream technology and offtake constraints. The component flags and causal removal declarations are explicit Class-D design assumptions, not observations or engineering confirmations. The common competition envelope aggregates the two existing Class-D downstream product-route triplets (0/36/34 and2.5/3.6/5.2 kt); it is not a casthouse nameplate, conversion coefficient or empirical market estimate. Preserve each existing per-opportunity competition control. Existing fully resolving routes6/4 remain selected and block escalation to route8.
